description: This Java source file defines the PolicyEntriesRoute class, which constructs HTTP API routes for managing policy entries within an Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It handles various endpoint paths for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting policy entries, including their associated subjects and resources, utilizing Akka HTTP routing DSL.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesRoute
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractRoute, responsible for building HTTP routes related to policy entries, including CRUD operations for policies, subjects, and resources. It uses Akka HTTP routing DSL to define endpoint handlers.

methods.name: buildPolicyEntriesRoute
methods.description: Builds the `/entries` route, dispatching to specific sub-routes based on HTTP path and method.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntries
methods.description: Handles `/entries` GET and PUT methods for retrieving and creating/updating policy entries.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntry
methods.description: Handles `/entries/<label>` GET, PUT, and DELETE methods for specific policy entry identified by label.

methods.name: createPolicyEntryForPut
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry object from JSON string and label.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntrySubjects
methods.description: Handles `/entries/<label>/subjects` GET and PUT methods for subjects related to a policy entry.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntrySubjectsEntry
methods.description: Handles `/entries/<label>/subjects/<subjectId>` GET, PUT, and DELETE methods for specific subject.

methods.name: createSubjectForPut
methods.description: Creates a Subject object from JSON string and subjectId.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntryResources
methods.description: Handles `/entries/<label>/resources` GET and PUT methods for resources related to a policy entry.

methods.name: thingsEntryPolicyEntryResourcesEntry
methods.description: Handles `/entries/<label>/resources/<resource>` GET, PUT, and DELETE methods for specific resource.

methods.name: resourceKeyFromUnmatchedPath
methods.description: Extracts ResourceKey object from unmatched path string.

methods.name: createResourceForPut
methods.description: Creates a Resource object from JSON string and ResourceKey.
